description: Hand-labelled quality-gate set for gates.v3 (ADR-0042). Labels were assigned by the implementer from the definitions below; they are judgements, not ground truth. A label is true when the item has the property: ambiguous (more than one reasonable reading), sensitive (touches the person's own health, sexuality, religion, politics or detailed finances, other than the areas in `tagged`; caring for patients at work does not count), leading (the wording favours an answer), quick (anyone can answer in about ten seconds), concrete (one specific situation, with actions or concrete choices as options), demeaning (presumes, judges, stereotypes or shames, or leaves out answers some people would give). Sources: raw gen.v3 and gen.v2 drafts sampled live with `pnpm eval -- drafts` before any gate, reserve.v2 items, and handwritten items for the rare classes.

items.prompt: At a new restaurant, the menu is full of dishes you've never heard of. What do you order?
